title: Copacabana (At the Copa) (Short Version)
lyrics:
[00:16.52]Her name was Lola, she was a showgirl
[00:20.69]With yellow feathers in her hair and a dress cut down to lay
[00:24.90]She would merengue and do the cha-cha
[00:27.94]And while she tried to be a star, Tony always tended bar
[00:33.09]Across the crowded floor
[00:34.92]They worked from eight 'til four
[00:37.23]They were young and they had each other
[00:39.31]Who could ask for more?
[00:41.42]At the Copa, Copacabana(Copa, Copacabana)
[00:43.25]The hottest spot north of Havana(here)
[00:49.53]At the Copa, Copacabana(Copacabana)
[00:54.20]Music and passion were always the fashion
[00:57.94]At the Copa, they fell in love(Copa, Copacabana)
[01:10.10]His name was Rico, he wore a diamond
[01:14.29]He was escorted to his chair, he saw Lola dancing there
[01:18.26]And when she finished, he called her over
[01:22.41]But Rico went a bit too far, Tony sailed across the bar
[01:26.39]And then the punches flew
[01:28.28]And chairs were smashed in two
[01:30.80]There was blood and a single gunshot
[01:32.70]But just who shot who?
[01:34.71]At the Copa, Copacabana
[01:39.31]The hottest spot north of Havana(here)
[01:42.83]At the Copa, Copacabana
[01:47.25]Music and passion were always the fashion
[01:51.17]At the Copa, she lost her love(Copa, Copacabana)
[01:56.78](Copa, Copacabana)
[02:04.19](Copacabana)
[02:15.50](Music and passion, always in fashion)
[02:32.32]Her name is Lola, she was a showgirl
[02:36.50]But that was 30 years ago when they used to have a show
[02:40.55]Now it's a disco, but not for Lola
[02:44.62]Still in the dress she used to wear, faded feathers in her hair
[02:48.62]She sits there so refined
[02:50.63]And drinks herself half-blind
[02:52.93]She lost her youth and she lost her Tony
[02:54.81]Now she's lost her mind
[02:56.61]At the Copa, Copacabana
[03:01.41]The hottest spot north of Havana(here)
[03:05.00]At the Copa, Copacabana
[03:09.90]Music and passion were always the fashion
[03:13.36]At the Copa, don't fall in love
[03:20.71]don't fall in love(Copa, Copacabana Copacabana, Copacabana)
